## Why

Wave 7 (2026-11-03): five Claude fallback runs (sonnet and haiku) paused on report shape. The implementer prompt lists the report as a numbered list (`internal/roles/prompts/implementer.md:128-146`): item 4 is "One line `Tests: N passed, M failed` ..." and item 7 is "`## Owner needed`: ...". The fallback copied the numbering into the headings (`## 4. Tests`, `## 7. Owner needed`) and added text after the counts (`Tests: 3216 passed, 0 failed (1 skipped ...)`). The shape check accepts only `^Tests: (\d+) passed, (\d+) failed\r?$` and the heading `## Owner needed` (`internal/engine/report.go:104-106`), so each run paused with `no "Tests: N passed, M failed" line` and `no "## Owner needed" section`. `ork retry` with no text fixed both runs I resumed. The prompt tells the role what the lines mean but never shows the exact text a role may copy.

Roles that need the lines (`internal/engine/report.go:119-148`): the implementer (not its finish step) and the gate need the Tests line; every role needs `## Owner needed`.

## Implement

1. Tests first from the failing list; confirm each fails for the reason given.
2. In `implementer.md`, after the numbered list, add: "The numbers above are for you. They are not part of the report: never number a heading. These two lines are read by a program and must appear exactly as shown, each on its own line, with nothing before or after them on that line:" followed by a fenced block holding `Tests: N passed, M failed` and `## Owner needed`. Say: replace N and M with integers; put skipped or blocked tests under item 6, not on the Tests line; when you ran no tests, write the counts of what you ran and say why in item 6.
3. In `gate.md`, show the same Tests line as its own literal line and say the heading is `## Owner needed`, no number, with nothing else on its line.
4. In `reviewer.md`, `architect.md`, `ui.md`, `spec-check.md`, add the one sentence: the heading is exactly `## Owner needed`, with no number and nothing after it.
5. Do not change `internal/engine/report.go` or the shape check. Do not change the brief (`internal/engine/brief.go`); S277 owns brief wording.
6. Keep the prompt's first-line contract text, the placeholder list and `{{report_path}}` as they are (`TestPlaceholders`, `TestPromptsFirstLineNamesTheirContract` stay green).
